719-3899-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-3899-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Repeat from step 3.

2178-4681-6542-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 4.
2178-4681-6542-8095.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 4.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 4 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2021-2060-5902-7315.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

4399-4518-5468-6626.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Kambal trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kambal trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-5468-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

3375-4399-4770-6720.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3375-4399-4770-6720.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

874-1170-1329-4460.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1329-4460.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1879-4091-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate one of the Aphetto Alchemist tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Aphetto Alchemist token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1170-3363-3581-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
Kykar and Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking The One Ring and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

678-2511-4826-6644.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

198-3918-4896.description:
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Trazyn and adding {W} or {U} for each charge counter on Trazyn.
Activate High Alert by paying {2}{W}{U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.
198-3918-4896.notes: In order to have a starting cost of {W/U}, Trazyn must have three or more charge counters to start the combo. If it has less, you will need to supply additional mana to supply the combo until Trazyn gets enough counters.

997-3139--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature.
The sacrificed creature's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
The Great Henge triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to draw a card.
The -1/-1 and +1/+1 counters are removed as a state-based action.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1491-6006-6218-6260.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-6006-6218-6260.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
1491-6006-6218-6260.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

914-1879-3335.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1879-3335.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U}{R}.
Cast Lady Sun by paying {1}{U}{U}.
Activate Lady Sun by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
914-1879-3335.notes: If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

976-2042-4067.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 3.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {B}.
976-2042-4067.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Golgari Brownscale, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Greed by paying {B} and 2 life, causing you to mill two cards and return Golgari Brownscale from your graveyard to your hand.
Golgari Brownscale triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

1202-4659-5003-5542.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, it triggers twice and Nim Deathmantle triggers once.
Resolve both Myr Moonvessel triggers, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

1096-2376-5256.notablePrerequisites: Woodfall Primus does not have a -1/-1 counters on it.
1096-2376-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Woodfall Primus.
Woodfall Primus's persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield with no counters on it due to Woodfall Primus's riot ability.
Woodfall Primus enters the battlefield, destroying target noncreature permanent.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia's ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Woodfall Primus' power.
Repeat.

1124-2156-2495-2858.description:
Activate Chandra, Torch of Defiance's second ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Chandra, Bold Pyromancer's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, adding {R}{R} and dealing 2 damage to a player.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Tezzeret's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping The Chain Veil.
Repeat.

527-4235-4964.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power five or greater.
Selvala and Niblis do not have summoning sickness.
527-4235-4964.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Niblis by paying {U} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Niblis' ability, targeting Selvala.
Resolve both Niblis abilities, untapping Niblis and Selvala.
Repeat.

112-796-2440-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Zombies.
112-796-2440-4050.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}.
Poppet Stitcher triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
The Zombie enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Clockspinning, allowing you to give or remove a counter from a creature that has a counter on it and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {U}.
Repeat.
